name: ygege
description: Ygege - high-performance public YGG indexer relay for Prowlarr and Jackett.

ports.name: Web/API Port
ports.description: Port used by Prowlarr or Jackett to reach the ygege relay.

variables.name: Bind IP
variables.description: Address the ygege service listens on inside the container. Keep 0.0.0.0 for Docker/Unraid access.

variables.name: Bind Port
variables.description: Port the ygege service listens on inside the container. Keep this aligned with the container port mapping.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Log verbosity. Common values: debug, info, warn, error.
